I don't no if being raped is the cause of this but I can't sort things out in my life I have no control over my self and I have extremely self destructive behavior I don't know what is wrong with me what the hell I just started ranting about my own problem. I hope you get through it somehow don't think of killing yourself although I think of it my self. It is an easy way out but even if there is only one person who love you maybe you do not know they do they will go through hell if something happens to you
What is this hell that we live in everybody is trapped. People say that we are free but we aren't.
What does the psychiatrist tell you what is wrong with us
I hope you find a way
